name: WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO) OData API
application: Global health indicator time series (country/region) for epidemiological and comparative analysis
modality: Aggregate indicator data via OData REST API
file_formats: JSON (OData; /Indicator returned JSON with @odata.context); docs state default 'Observatory's XML schema'; Power BI OData feed
geographic_coverage: Worldwide: countries and 6 WHO regions (Africa, Americas, Europe, Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia, Western Pacific)
temporal_coverage: Indicator-dependent; filter via TimeDimensionBegin/TimeDimensionEnd (span not stated)
collection_method: WHO compilation of country-reported and WHO-estimated indicators (aggregation level: country/region/global, indicator-dependent)
license: Not reported on API page (WHO 'Terms of use' linked in footer)
download_method: OData REST queries with $filter on dimensions/time
limitations: Assessment: indicator definitions, disaggregation and years vary per indicator; reporting frequency not stated.
verification_method: WebFetch of WHO GHO OData API docs page + live https://ghoapi.azureedge.net/api/Indicator?$top=3 (JSON)

name: WHO Mortality Database
download_or_api_url: Raw files (ICD-7, ICD-8, ICD-9, ICD-10 parts 1-6) from landing page; interactive portal https://platform.who.int/mortality
application: Cause-specific mortality analysis by country, age and sex
modality: Death registration counts (civil registration and vital statistics)
sample_count: Not reported (note: over '2 million records in one data file')
geographic_coverage: WHO Member States reporting CRVS data; some partial national coverage (e.g. 'Brazil (North and North-east)')
temporal_coverage: 1950 to date; ICD-10 files last updated 23 February 2026
collection_method: 'mortality data as reported annually by Member States from their civil registration and vital statistics systems'; aggregated by country-year, age, sex, underlying cause (as coded nationally)
missing_data: Death registration completeness may be <100%; completeness estimates provided for latest year
license: Non-commercial: 'no use will be made of them for commercial purposes'; WHO must be credited as source
access_prerequisites: Accept non-commercial use condition; credit WHO
download_method: Direct file download from landing page; interactive portal
citation: Not reported (publications must credit WHO as source)
limitations: Coverage/completeness varies; 'cross-national differences in coding practices' must be considered; raw files require DBMS; multiple ICD revisions.
verification_method: WebFetch of WHO Mortality Database landing page

name: WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC)
download_or_api_url: https://srhdpeuwpubsa-geecgzbpd5h0fueu.z01.azurefd.net/whdh/WIISE/export/coverage-data.xlsx (all vaccination coverage data); WUENIC country summary: https://immunizationdata.who.int/docs/librariesprovider21/additional-datasets/wuenic-input-to-pdf.xlsx
application: National vaccination coverage trends by antigen; programme monitoring
geographic_coverage: WHO and UNICEF Member States (national level), with global/regional summaries
temporal_coverage: Estimates through 2025; released annually in July
collection_method: WHO/UNICEF estimates from country-reported data and coverage surveys (country-level annual)
missing_data: Estimates include Member States 'that did not report 2025 data'
license: Not reported (WHO Terms of use linked in footer)
download_method: Direct xlsx download; dashboards; WHO VISTA app
limitations: Assessment: modelled estimates; annual national aggregates only.
mirrors: Related: coverage survey data xlsx on same portal
verification_method: WebFetch of immunizationdata.who.int home + Download page

name: CDC WONDER Underlying Cause of Death
download_or_api_url: Online query system https://wonder.cdc.gov/ucd-icd10.html (and single-race 2018-2024 database)
application: US mortality counts and rates by cause, geography and demographics
feature_count: Variables: age groups, race, Hispanic ethnicity, sex, ICD-10 4-digit cause, 113 selected causes, injury intent/mechanism, place of death, month, weekday, autopsy, urbanization
geographic_coverage: United States: national, region, state, county (by residence)
collection_method: Death certificates (NVSS); aggregated query output: counts, crude and age-adjusted rates with 95% CI
missing_data: Counts/rates based on 9 or fewer deaths suppressed
license: Data use restrictions: 'Use these data for health statistical reporting and analysis only. Do not present or publish death counts of 9 or fewer...'
access_prerequisites: Agree to data use restrictions before query (no re-identification; report inadvertent discoveries); access_level: click-through agreement
download_method: Interactive web query with table export; API not stated on fetched pages
limitations: Suppression of counts <10; violations can lead to penalties under 18 USC 1001; aggregate only.
verification_method: WebFetch of wonder.cdc.gov deaths-by-underlying-cause.html + ucd-icd10.html

name: Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) annual survey data
application: Chronic disease risk behaviours and preventive practices surveillance [risk factors]
target: Not applicable: respondent-level survey microdata; outcome chosen per study (correction by catalogue maintainer: this dataset is not aggregate)
geographic_coverage: 2024: 49 states, DC, Guam, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands (Tennessee excluded)
collection_method: Combined landline and cell phone telephone survey; raking weights (since 2011); annual, state-level design
missing_data: Tennessee excluded from 2024 due to insufficient data collection
limitations: Self-reported; 2011 weighting change limits comparability with earlier years (Assessment).
verification_method: WebFetch of BRFSS annual data index + 2024 annual data page
approx_size: 2024: ASCII 41.5 MB; SAS Transport ZIP 64.3 MB

name: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES)
application: Population health, nutrition, clinical exam and laboratory measures
modality: Survey microdata: interview, physical exam, laboratory
file_formats: Not reported on fetched pages (SAS Viewer referenced)
feature_count: Components: Demographics, Dietary, Examination, Laboratory, Questionnaire, Limited Access
target: Not applicable: respondent-level survey microdata; outcome chosen per study (correction by catalogue maintainer: this dataset is not aggregate)
geographic_coverage: United States (nationally representative)
temporal_coverage: Continuous cycles 1999-2000 onward; 2017-March 2020; Aug 2021-Aug 2023; 2025-2027 current; earlier NHANES I-III from 1959

verification_method: WebFetch of NHANES home, 2021-2023 cycle page, NHANES About page

name: NNDSS Weekly Data
application: Weekly provisional notifiable disease case surveillance [infectious disease surveillance]
modality: Aggregate weekly case counts by reporting area
sample_count: Not stated; metadata column stats show 2,000,040 non-null 'Reporting Area' values at fetch time (another fetch reported 1,991,640)
feature_count: Columns: Reporting Area, Current MMWR Year, MMWR Week, Label, Current week (+flag), Previous 52 week Max (+flag), Cumulative YTD current/previous year (+flags), Location1/2, Sort_order, Geocode
geographic_coverage: United States, U.S. territories, non-U.S. residents (reporting areas)
temporal_coverage: 2022-2026 (MMWR weeks); weekly updates (metadata: Weekly); last updated 2026-09-30
collection_method: NNDSS case notifications from state health departments; aggregation: reporting area x MMWR week x disease
missing_data: Provisional, 'subject to ongoing revision of information and delayed reporting'; many null current-week cells
citation: Attribution: Office of Public Health Data, Surveillance, and Technology, CDC
limitations: Provisional counts; delayed reporting; flags for suppressed/unavailable values.
verification_method: Socrata catalog API search + WebFetch of data.cdc.gov/api/views/x9gk-5huc.json
